event_description: Fresh Coast Light Lab & Travel Marquette present Lasers on the Ore Dock, Friday and Saturday starting 20 minutes after sunset, from approximately 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM! Asinaabi and the Living Stones was created by local indigenous artist, Aiyana Aldred. Watch her beautiful artwork come to life along the iron Ore Dock in this creative juxtaposition of culture in the Upper Peninsula. Catch the dazzling display light up the night sky and the north side of the Lower Harbor Ore Dock from Mattson Lower Harbor Park each month in 2026. Sit back and enjoy the show from your vehicle or take a stroll along Lake Superior while marveling at this unique opportunity in Marquette, MI! You'll definitely keep coming back every month to witness various themes, guest artists, and events all year long!

event_description: Winter adventure events in the Upper Peninsula. Registration for the 2027 events opens on 11/8/2026. EX opens 1/1/2027. The EX format is for participants who seek adventure, smaller gatherings, and personal competition. YOU vs. YOU! Be prepared - EX events are challenging. Participants are given a 60-day window to complete the event(s) of their choice. EX format requires checkpoint selfies and may utilize ungroomed surfaces. EX courses are generally less predictable and therefore more difficult. Mass start 2/20/2027. The mass start is a single-day event for those who enjoy the social aspect of large gatherings. You can race it or ride it, it’s up to you. Mass Start events do not require checkpoint selfies. Ultra 2/22/2027.
